capabilities: Zoom note content with modifier key plus scroll or pinch gestures
Remember zoom levels per tab or per note file
Show a status bar indicator with cycleable zoom presets and a draggable slider
Reset individual or all saved zoom levels via commands and hotkeys
Configure modifier key, step size, zoom range, presets, and language
extras: Desktop-only; the README states mobile is not supported yet. Installation instructions cover manual download and building from source.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually zoom the note content of a single tab without changing the app's global font size or scaling the whole interface.
summary: Zoom helper that scales note content with modifier key plus scroll, pinch gestures, and per-tab or per-note zoom memory.
